label: endRunDropped: endAdjust no longer ends the kernel's run, so one run spans two gestures
clampAsSuccess: an out-of-range jump runs, and the kernel's clamp lands it on an end instead of refusing
find: guard stroke == nil, historySteps.indices.contains(index), index != historyIndex else { return }
replace: guard stroke == nil, index != historyIndex else { return }

label: baseNotRolled: a step the limit drops leaves the base's name as it was
